tier.official: Publisher's own site (amazon.com, manufacturer domain). Usable as a citation.
tier.official_help: Amazon or government help/policy page. Usable as a citation.
tier.listing: Retailer product detail page. Usable for identity, marked listing-only for specs.
tier.not_used: Third-party review sites, aggregators, affiliate blogs. Never cited for a value.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (updated 2025-10-15)
sources.supports: Section 5 requires the exact statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' Section 1 requires tagged Special Links.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (updated 2026-04-14)
sources.supports: Price/availability display limited to Amazon-served links or Creators API/PA API; star ratings and reviews only via PA API; Associates ID must appear as a URL parameter; 24-hour session definition.

sources.title: Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
sources.supports: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous; '(paid link)', '#ad', '#CommissionsEarned' given as examples.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.supports: Affiliate relationship must be disclosed near the link and in the content itself; disclosure placement must be where readers will see it.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.supports: Definition of 'clear and conspicuous'; material connection disclosure duty.
